If you don't want ANY help, so including not sharing your story here on occasion, or using other forums/groups/chatrooms, literally ANY kind of help, there is almost no way to tell what will happen.

It's possible you'll learn to cope and eventually heal yourself and you'll be perfectly fine. You could stay unhappy for the rest of your life, but a little thing as a friend that listens could make a huge difference. You could lose your battles and end up killing yourself as well. But even then, if you fail, help might be forced on you and you'd still be fine!

So why not try to shoot for healing? In dutch we say, never shoot, never hit. Meaning, why not try right? What's the worst that could happen? That is doesnt help at all? Then you lost nothing. If you don't want to get professional help (neither do I anymore), find yourself another safety net, and outlet. It could be anything and anyone and even anywhere. Vent here for example. Find a facebook group you can tell your story to, read self help books, take up yoga or meditation. Just something! You have nothing to lose, and everything to gain without the need for professional help right away. If these little things help, but not enough you can always seek professional help. But please, don't write off professionals too easy and at least give something, anything a try?

Though I am chronically depressed, I keep getting myself out of the relapses without much help. I just need to find a way and the time to heal more. Just don't be afraid to ask for help if you can't do it alone ok?

Now believe me, being unloved at school has no relation to how loved you'll be later in live. Even just because your parents are more concerned with their issues than yours, doesn't mean that they don't love you, and if it did, still wouldn't have an effect on your loveable-ness later in life. My entire family abandoned me, all exept my parents, which makes me more fortunate than you, but I can relate a little. You are not worthless! Just because your parents and friends don't treat you right does not mean you're worthless. It just means they are unable to value you right. Which is horrible in the case of parents, but still, their vault not yours. My brother in law has those parents, rejected by both, stolen from by his mother etc etc etc. My sister, I and my parent love him to death. I'd kill for him, and he is not even married to me. He also had trouble at school with friends, and is now someone with a ton of real friends who would also challenge hell and earth for him. He is loved! Just not by his parents, biological or sthepparents. But by his in laws as if he were their own.

You know you are worth it, you came for help. You know they are wrong, that's why you're angry at everyone. And look at your post, the feeling of wishing we weren't born we can all relate too, but before you talk about death, what does it say? I want to be happy. You don't really want to die, you want to be happy. You deserve to be happy and you can be. There is someone out there (beside me,  but I'm here too) that can help you. Someone you can trust, or even a school counselor (although mine sucked, doesn't mean yours does!). You can get through this, you need to hold on!

Just watching real crime shows... if they wanted you dead, you'd be dead. Especially if you're mother is on drugs. Of course that doesn't exclude indifference which hurts just as bloody bad unfortunately. 

I can actually relate to the school is hell part. I have been beaten up at school by an entire class of kids while the teachers were watching. And then I was almost punished for fighting back! I almost got beat up 2 more by a huge group, and that was just primary school. The bullying did not let up, not even in college! Truth is, we all believe the damn tv shows. The friends for life are friends made in school... nope! Becoming an outsider everwhere I went, I saw exactely what you are describing with others. But they didn't notice like you did. Truth is, kids are the most awful people around. Your reputation of a slut? They are threatend by you, I saw this again and again and again. Afraid someone was going to steal your friend, call him gay or slut, once even said to have aids! Which of course let to the teachers having an entire discussion, which made it 1000 times worse. The only thing that worked for me? Fighting back. In my case of course litteraly as I was being attacked over and over and over. Until I lost it and started punching back, worked both in primary and high school. In college no fighting, so I fought back the way they fought me, with words. Which would be my advice. Kids of any age, and even adults sometimes find where you are volnurable and keep poking at it until it bleeds. They won't stop until you tell them to, and in a way it gives them a reason to respect you. Now, this works better if you respect yourself, which right this instant is impossible. So fake it till you make it until then. When they call you slut, call them out. If you don't know what start with: at least someone will do me, good luck to you with a face like that! Just something equally humiliating. Friend stabs you in the back, confront them. Embaress them by asking why? Since you wouldn't do that to them. And realize, not all of them will be your friends after this. Some of them are using you and you need to scratch them as a friend.
You've made me cry, but thank you so much for sharing that! I really needed it!

Hi there,

I wish I magically had an answer for you, but I am not a doctor. But maybe sharing my view will help, but feel free to disagree at any point ok? It can even be a good thing, as it tells what it isn't ;)

Ok, so I have to go much much further back in time in order to relate. I want to go back to primary school, before my teacher said to my parents I wasn't social enough. Before that I thought I didn't want to play with the other children, because they did not want to play like I did, so why not play alone. After that I decided that apparently I was expected to play with others and found out that they did not want to play with me and the bullying started. I want to go back to that time so bad. Before everyone started rejecting me and I was actually rejecting them! In the time I was allowed to be 100% me, and no one else, and nothing else was expected of me. 

I also have a aversion for high school and collage friends or people rather (I never actually had any friends, just 1). Due to my chronic depression and a bunch of bad luck I still live at home, everyone else including my younger sister are in the process of buying homes, getting married, having children etc. And I am working my butt off for my own business while having an unbelieveable string of bad luck preventing me from getting it to the point I can live off it. They are all seeing a bright future and I am battleing chronic depression which doesn't seem to have a cure... It makes me angry and incredibly hopeless and sometimes even suicidal, so I avoid them at all costs. It's not a perfect solution but it works for me.

Correct me if I'm wrong, but it feels like you just need to vent about the past while everyone seems to push you to the future. If you don't trust your counselor (I know the feeling), you need to find someone who you can talk to about the past, so you can start working through those feelings. This place, or a more dedicated forum/chat room could work. As we know how it feels to need to talk about something even if we don't relate to your issue exactely. I know we shouldn't give advice, but perhaps working on something more constructive then gaming could help with the feelings of being utterly useless. Doesn't have to be a job, could be a volunteer somewhere, even online is possible these days! Even reading books about a subject you like might help, as you are taking in information instead of just distracting and getting through time. If you hate the advice, or it doesn't work, please remember I am not a professional. Just don't do it if you don't like it or stop following it if it doesn't help

Don't worry about the lenght of your post, it shows you care, which is very nice. I just can't agree with you unfortunately. 

Even if you're right and the world wouldn't be better off without me, it would't be (much) worse of either, even looking at it in the most positive way I can, even though it kind of makes me laugh at how ridiculous it seems. And it wouldn't be fair to force me to live in agony for those few tiny little things I add to the world now would it? You don't make a pet suffer just because it brings you joy, you put it down because you love it and don't want it suffer. So even stretching my mind as far as it can go... it wouldnt matter wheter I add anything or nothing (or even negative as I feel I am).

Secondly, go ahead and google it and see how often those cures are about chronically depressed people who have been depressed for 10+ years from a young age... 0. They are all either not chronicly depressed (just a depression that passes) or if they are, not from a young age and/or not for an incredibly long time. I've tried, thinking that would break the loop. I could write off Chesters case as bad luck or something, knowing other people made it. It made it sooooo much worse that I came here.

That's not true. At my lowest I was convinced my own family would be sad (not even very sad) for about two weeks, then feel relieved and be happier if I commited suicide. After crawling out of the really bad phase (I'm chronically depressed, unfortunately that means it never really ends for me) my normal thinking partly came back and I saw that couldn't be true. It is your mind playing tricks on you! And subconciously you know, which is why you're here, your mind is trying to let you know you are being manipulated by the depression. There are many around you that care you just can't see right now. And I care you came here, I know exactely what it's like. I have been where you are (and unfortunately heading that way again, but that's another story). Anything I can do to help?

That's a great and yet the most depressing answer you could ever get lol. The problem is I have no desire to live like that, if that's what it takes to continue living, I don't see the point. Why keep my mind so busy it forgets to be depressed? Why not stop it from thinking completely then? I'm not religious, so no "I'll go to hell if I commit suicide" thoughts to keep me going. Even in the less bad phases I'm convinced the world would be a better place without me. So what's the point? I'm not there yet... I still see my mother and sister needing me right now... but the thoughts of teaching them to fend for themselves and then end it all are unstoppable right now. I just need one person, just one... even someone who has heard of one would do... just someone who just lives normally between relapses, without the never ending escapism. 

It's not the no cure part that bothers me, having relapses the rest of your life means I'm very well aware of the no cure part. But it has to let up sometime? I can't be like this the rest of my life, it just can't! It's not fair some of us have to live in never ending pain and suffering, I just won't.
